metadata.title: Download Brutalist with Claude Code
metadata.note: The second film in the Brutalist playlist for @HumanitariansAI. Audience: fellows who already have Claude Code and now want to try Brutalist. Argument: downloading Brutalist is not an install wizard, it's a git clone plus a free doctor script; the Claude Code subscription is what runs the agent, but the Brutalist pipeline itself (Kokoro, Manim, Remotion) is free. Paid API is a separate, optional lane. ILLUSTRATE LAW: Claude UI only at B00 ASK and B08 YOUR TURN. Body beats are concept illustrations (Dbc*). Custom native outro (DbcOutro) hardcodes @HumanitariansAI to respect OUTRO-LOCK on the shipped ClaudeTitleOutro.
metadata.reformat: portrait graphics; captured-media crop in short/media only

skin_warnings: B00: palette=claude but the cold open is 'ClaudeComposerAsk916' — COLD OPEN LAW wants ClaudeComposerAsk
B09: palette=claude but the outro is 'DbcOutro916' — OUTRO LAW wants ClaudeTitleOutro

beats.narration_text: Ciao. This is Liam, in for Bear. You already have Claude Code. So downloading Brutalist is one paste into the composer. Not a wizard, not a package. A git clone, a free doctor script, and a readiness table. Here is what actually happens.

show.event: cream Claude page fades in with the topic eyebrow and the segment 'Download Brutalist'
greeting 'Ciao, Liam' resolves above the composer
the ask types itself into the composer
running indicator appears, then three concrete output lines settle beneath

props.command: Clone the public Brutalist toolkit into this folder and run the free setup doctor for me.

beats.narration_text: Now run the doctor. Dot slash setup dash dash install once, to pull the free dependencies. Then plain dot slash setup, over and over, to see the readiness table. Green means the feature is live. Red means one dependency is missing, and the doctor tells you exactly which install command to run. It is the same script the sandbox in this reel just executed — the readings on screen are real.

show.event: eyebrow 'BRUTALIST · READINESS TABLE' and title 'Green means ready.'
terminal card opens with '$ ./setup' typed on top
table header 'FEATURE  STATUS' arrives
rows arrive: audio (Kokoro), captions, Manim beats, Manim equations, Remotion beats, slates, fonts
final green line: 'All core features ready. Cost: $0.00.'

props.sparkLine: The doctor tells you what's blocked, and how to fix it.

beats.narration_text: This part trips fellows up, so read it slowly. Your Claude Code subscription is what lets the agent think and write. That is one lane. A paid Anthropic API key is a different lane — optional, metered, only needed if you script Claude outside the desktop app. Brutalist itself doesn't spend a cent. Kokoro is a local voice model. Remotion renders on your machine. Manim runs on your machine. Free by default — that is the shape of this tool.

show.event: eyebrow 'BRUTALIST · THREE LANES' and title 'Subscription. Optional key. Free pipeline.'
left lane 'CLAUDE CODE SUBSCRIPTION' with the composer icon lights
middle lane 'PAID ANTHROPIC API' arrives, marked OPTIONAL in terracotta
right lane 'BRUTALIST PIPELINE' arrives with Kokoro / Remotion / Manim rows
banner underneath: 'Setup spends $0.00'

props.sparkLine: Subscription runs the agent. Brutalist itself is free.

beats.narration_text: Now the honest limits. Setup does not sign you into anything — no accounts are created. Setup does not touch any file outside the folder you cloned into. Setup does not upload. It does download one thing from the public internet the first time you run install — the Kokoro voice model, about three hundred forty megabytes, straight from a GitHub release. That is the whole network footprint.

show.event: eyebrow 'BRUTALIST · SETUP HONESTY' and title 'What setup won't do.'
row one: 'No accounts created.' 'setup asks for zero credentials.'
row two: 'No files outside this folder.' 'everything lives in the clone.'
row three: 'No upload. One download.' '~340MB Kokoro voice model from a GitHub release.'

props.sparkLine: The tool has a shape. That shape is the honesty.

beats.narration_text: Verdict, in three lines. Clone the repo — you have the toolkit. Run the doctor — you know exactly what is ready. Keep the free lane — the pipeline itself never asks for a card. That is how you download Brutalist.

show.event: artifact card animates in, cream stage
artifact title 'Verdict' and heading 'Download Brutalist, in three lines.'
line 1 arrives on cue
line 2 arrives
line 3 arrives

artifactLines: Clone the public repo. You now own the toolkit as plain files.
Run ./setup --install once, then ./setup any time. The doctor tells you what's ready.
The pipeline is free by default. Your Claude Code subscription runs the agent; Brutalist itself never asks for a card.
props.sparkLine: That is how you download Brutalist.

beats.narration_text: That was Download Brutalist with Claude Code. Liam, in for Bear. For Humanitarians AI.
